title: Stock-market slides this steep and fast trigger a rebound 91% of the time over the last decade
html:
The big question for traders is whether the S&P 500’s swift fall into a correction is the start of something much worse for the stock market or actually a harbinger of a reversal

Over the last decade – from 2015, to be more precise – drops of 10% over 50 trading days, like now, have been met with positive S&P 500 SPX returns for the next 50 days 91% of the time, according to Jessica Rabe, co-founder of DataTrek Research.
summary: The big question for traders is whether the S&P 500’s swift fall into a correction is the start of something much worse for the stock market or actually a harbinger of a reversal.
